notablePrerequisites: You control and own a green nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
The Cauldron of Eternity and Verdant Succession both trigger.
Resolve The Cauldron of Eternity trigger first, putting the creature on the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature to the battlefield.
Repeat.
